Disclosure 3-3 Management of material topics
Additional sector recommendations
• Describe the pest management plan of the organization, including the
rationale for the selection and application of pesticides and any other practices
of pest control.
• Describe actions taken to prevent, mitigate and/or remediate negative impacts
associated with the use of extremely and highly hazardous pesticides.
• Describe the actions, initiatives, or plans to switch to less hazardous
pesticides and actions taken to optimize pest control practices.
• Describe the training provided to workers on pest management and the
application of pesticides.
